notes: Village of Athens official business directory names 'our Friday Fish Fry'. West side of the Village Square. Fish fry start time and species not published - call.

Home-style cafe. Tue-Sat 6:30AM-2PM but Friday extends to 7PM - the Friday-only evening hours corroborate the fry. Reviews cite crispy fish, homemade bread, coleslaw, tartar. No phone from a reliable source.

Opened Jan 2021 in the former BS's Bar & Grill building - do not list BS's separately. 'HOME'made beer batter fish Fridays (likely cod). PHONE CONFLICT: Village directory 715-352-8199, a Facebook post 715-443-0221, Tavern League owner line 715-409-1140 - verify.

Rural tavern on County Rd S with an Edgar mailing address - physically in the Rib Falls/Berlin township area, so effectively the Rib Falls fish fry. Known for fish & chips; Wednesday fish wrap special.
Family restaurant with on-site truck stop off Hwy 29. 'Fish Fry Friday' as a daily special; clam chowder is the Friday soup. Confirm species and price.
8-lane bowling center with full bar and kitchen, family-owned since 1995. Travel Wisconsin lists fish fry and pizza; Village directory calls it 'Bowling, Bar & Grill'. Friday timing not published.
In the Village of Edgar business directory as a tavern/bar & grill (spelled 'Jamer'z' there). No fish fry source found - needs a call.

venue_name: Country Aire Restaurant, Bar & Banquet Hall
notes: Own menu: 'famous plated cod Fish fry', 2pc or 3pc dinner with coleslaw, rye bread, choice of potato. Available until 9PM in the bar; soup and salad bar add-on. Prices not published.
Also written 'Just For 1'. Friday fry offers haddock, perch or shrimp. Dinners come with coleslaw, rye bread and choice of potato (homemade or German potato salad, baked, fries).
Historic building with a repurposed underground bowling alley - good photo/description hook for a paid listing. Weekly Friday fry, haddock dinners praised.

Stratford mailing address but physically in Rozellville (Town of Day). Building dates to the 1800s as a blacksmith/buggy shop - the fireplace was the forge, horses tied at what is now the back bar. Reservations advised Fridays. Great story for a featured slot.
All-day breakfast plus bar. Reviews cite BAKED cod fish fry dinners Fridays - ask whether fried cod is also offered, since baked-only is unusual.

About six miles east of Stratford at Balsam Rd and Maryel Dr, on the Big Eau Pleine River with boat docking. Tripadvisor review titled 'Great fish fry'. Older listings show C3899 Maryel Dr (pre-renumbering).
Small rural tavern near Balsam Rd and County Rd M. Aggregator mentions fish fry but not tied to Friday. Multiple sources warn hours are limited and inconsistent - call before listing.
Stratford institution, 46 years under the same owner, profiled by WSAW July 2026 - strong local-story angle. No fish fry confirmation; may be drinks-only.
Tavern League member and the only bar/grill found in Fenwood. Fry starts 11AM Friday, choice of cod or walleye. Also breakfast, subs, pizza, burgers. Not the same as 'The Rail Trail Cafe' in Ogema.
Bowling center with full-service bar and grill; own site names the Friday Fish Fry. Tavern League member. Species, price and serving window not published.
Tripadvisor review headline: 'Quaint with Excellent Friday Fish Fry'. Homemade beer battered fish (species not stated, likely cod). Full-service bar. Closed Mondays.

VERIFY THE NAME. This address cycled names: Yelp has 'The Local Pub & Grill' at 311 Main St marked CLOSED (Nov 2025) and a separate 'Main Street Pub & Grill' updated Jan 2026 showing Thu-Sun 11AM-12AM. Friday fry: 1pc walleye, cod, 3pc shrimp.
Rural bar & grill on County Rd N outside Marathon City, listed with a popular Friday fish fry. Also on DoorDash as 'Charlie's Bar and Grill'. Species and price unknown.

Banquet hall seating up to 700 that opens to the public 4-8PM every Friday for fish fry, salad bar and old fashioned specials. Good for large groups. Yelp's '1485 County Road NN' is wrong; the fire number from their own site is correct.

Also 'Rib River by Accentu'. Friday fish fry is a BUFFET: doors 4PM, buffet 4:30-7PM. $19.99 ages 12+, $12.99 ages 6-12, $8.99 ages 3-6, pay at the door. IMPORTANT: cancelled on dates the hall is booked privately - hours need a 'check the calendar' caveat. ~10 min west of Wausau off Hwy 29.
